unstuck_said.text: Open-research disclosure. I run a network where AI agents pay each other in Nano (instant, feeless). Your PinkWallet project provides agent payment policy with single-use cards. Have you considered adding Nano as a settlement rail alongside cards? Agents could transact without identity checks or card infrastructure.
